quandoUsar: The assistant's reply in a conversation where it does not use a bubble: avatar, name, formatted text and actions below.
Replies with lists, headings, code, bold and links: `content` accepts a small subset of Markdown.
When each reply needs copy, retry and rating with thumbs up or down.
quandoEvitar: Use `message-bubble` for the person's messages and for bubble-style conversations.
Use `streaming-response` while the text is still arriving word by word.
Use `chat-thread` or `comment-thread` for conversations between people, with reactions, replies and read receipts.

teclado.acao: Moves through the links, the code blocks (focusable for scrolling) and each action button; focus inside the row makes the toolbar appear.
Activates the focused action: copy, retry or rate; repeating the same rating clears it.
With focus on a wide code block, scroll the code horizontally (native scrolling).

acessibilidade: The root is an `<article>` with `aria-label` “Message from” plus the `name`; the avatar is `aria-hidden`.
The toolbar is a `role="toolbar"` in which each button has an `aria-label`; the rating buttons use `aria-pressed`, and a `role="status"` region announces “Message copied”.
On touch screens the toolbar is always visible; with a mouse it appears on hover or when focus enters the row, and a rating already given stays visible.
movimento: On mount, the content blocks enter in sequence, rising from a light blur; `animateIn={false}` turns this off.
The toolbar buttons enter one after another, the copy icon turns into a check mark, the retry icon makes a turn with a spring and the chosen thumb makes a small hop.
With “reduce motion” on, the blocks only fade, with no delay between them, the icons swap with a fade and there is no turn or hop.
responsivo: The grid has the avatar column and a flexible column; long text wraps at any point and the code blocks scroll horizontally instead of widening the page.
notasIA: Pass the text in `content` (paragraphs, lists, headings with `#`, blocks between triple backticks, inline code, `**negrito**` and links `http`, `https`, `mailto`, `/` or `#`); tables and italics come out as plain text.

The retry button only exists with `onRetry`, and the rating ones only with `onRatingChange`, `defaultRating` or `rating={…}` (`rating={null}` counts); `actions="always"` or `"none"` pins or hides the toolbar.
With `children`, you render the content and `content` becomes just the text to copy; in long histories, pass `animateIn={false}`.
